linkedin:
Only 23% of remote job listings actually reveal their pay.

Out of 4,441 active remote listings on Loker Dollar, only 1,000 include a salary or hourly figure. The remaining 3,441 (77%) keep compensation private, so applicants can't compare rates before applying.

Communication is the most required skill (39% of 4,282 listings analyzed). AI is now a prerequisite in 12% of roles — the fastest-growing requirement. Leadership follows at 10%.

2,753 listings (about 62%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world, including Indonesia. 1,560 companies are posting remote roles. Active employers include Neo Financial, TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether — only Neo Financial disclosed its rate ($5 USD/hour).

Our take: missing pay doesn't equal low wages. Many firms expect candidates to negotiate.

Browse the live board, filter for "worldwide remote," and apply before listings close. Full data: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
